decision_snapshot_window: observed at or after 21:00 UTC on the decision Friday and before 21:00 UTC the following Friday
realization_snapshot_window: observed at or after 21:00 UTC on the realization Friday and before 21:00 UTC the following Friday
decision_packet_policy: immutable packet must contain point-in-time control and residual target weights, a workspace-relative source manifest and its hash, source_data_through no later than the decision Friday, and a packet hash
observation_packet_policy: immutable packet must contain security-level total returns for every held security, a workspace-relative source manifest and its hash, the completed realization week, and a packet hash
missed_snapshot_policy: a missed weekly decision or realization window cannot be backfilled from a later vintage
mutation_policy: any formula, weight, cost, financing, timing, data-policy, or pinned-file change creates a new protocol version and restarts its clock at zero
log_policy: decision and observation JSON Lines logs are independently hash-chained; duplicate, out-of-order, pre-freeze, changed, or unhashed records are rejected
first_decision_turnover_policy: conservative full transition from cash for both sleeves
selection_status: selected after observing the historical sample; forward evidence is mandatory and historical results never advance this clock
promotion_gate: 52 untouched weekly observations plus a separately predeclared statistical review; clock completion alone does not authorize promotion
